# Scope of Work — Meridian Sports — Search & Mobile (Meeting A)

_Status: DRAFT — requires human approval before sending. Pipeline: scope-pipeline-v1_

## Requirements (with feasibility checked against product knowledge)

### REQ-001 — We want customers to find products and local coaches faster
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **needs_clarification**
- Feasibility note: No matching documented capability found. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence — expert to confirm.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: we want customers to find products and local coaches faster (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: Our website search isn't great. We want customers to find products and local coaches faster.”

### REQ-002 — We need filters — by category, by location, maybe by membership level
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: must-have · Feasibility: **existing_configuration**
- Feasibility note: Search filters (category/location/level) and radius search are settings under Search Settings.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: we need filters — by category, by location, maybe by membership level (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (James): “James: Right now people type a sport and get hundreds of results in random order. We need filters — by category, by location, maybe by membership level.”

### REQ-003 — We also want visitors to search within, say, 10 miles of their postcode
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **existing_configuration**
- Feasibility note: Search filters (category/location/level) and radius search are settings under Search Settings.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: we also want visitors to search within, say, 10 miles of their postcode (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: We also want visitors to search within, say, 10 miles of their postcode. That's how our customers actually think.”

### REQ-004 — Maybe add AI search as well?
- Status: **unclear** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **potential_custom_development**
- Feasibility note: Built-in search has no AI semantic ranking or typo tolerance beyond partial matches.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: maybe add ai search as well? (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: Maybe add AI search as well? Like, it understands what people mean, not just exact words. And it should handle typos — people spell coach names wrong all the time.”

### REQ-005 — And it should handle typos — people spell coach names wrong all the time
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **potential_custom_development**
- Feasibility note: Built-in search has no AI semantic ranking or typo tolerance beyond partial matches.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: and it should handle typos — people spell coach names wrong all the time (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: Maybe add AI search as well? Like, it understands what people mean, not just exact words. And it should handle typos — people spell coach names wrong all the time.”

### REQ-006 — We want a better mobile experience — search should be obvious on phones
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **existing_with_limitation**
- Feasibility note: Themes responsive; mobile search-bar position is a Design Setting. Custom mobile layouts need dev.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: we want a better mobile experience — search should be obvious on phones (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (James): “James: On mobile it's worse. The search box is buried. We want a better mobile experience — search should be obvious on phones.”

### REQ-007 — Search and mobile are the must-haves for phase one
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: must-have · Feasibility: **existing_with_limitation**
- Feasibility note: Themes responsive; mobile search-bar position is a Design Setting. Custom mobile layouts need dev.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: search and mobile are the must-haves for phase one (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: Also our listing pages look dated. But search first. Search and mobile are the must-haves for phase one.”

### REQ-008 — We were hoping to launch before Christmas
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **needs_clarification**
- Feasibility note: Timeline statement — not a product feature; confirm as project constraint.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: we were hoping to launch before christmas (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (James): “James: We were hoping to launch before Christmas. Budget — we'd like to keep phase one under about 80 hours of work if possible, but tell us what's realistic.”

### REQ-009 — One more thing — premium members pay us more, so ideally they appear higher in results
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **needs_clarification**
- Feasibility note: Docs describe keyword search + filters; paid-tier ranking boost is not documented.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: one more thing — premium members pay us more, so ideally they appear higher in results (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: One more thing — premium members pay us more, so ideally they appear higher in results. Not sure if that's a setting.”

## Explicit exclusions (from client's own words)

- Agreed. We do not want to pay for custom code if a setting does the job.
- No redesign of the whole site. And no mobile app right now — website only.
- And member payments are fine as they are. Don't touch billing.

## Open questions (do not estimate as firm work until answered)

- REQ-001: We want customers to find products and local coaches faster — No matching documented capability found. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence — expert to confirm.
- REQ-004: Maybe add AI search as well? — Built-in search has no AI semantic ranking or typo tolerance beyond partial matches.
- REQ-008: We were hoping to launch before Christmas — Timeline statement — not a product feature; confirm as project constraint.
- REQ-009: One more thing — premium members pay us more, so ideally they appear higher in results — Docs describe keyword search + filters; paid-tier ranking boost is not documented.

## Effort summary

- Low: **37 h** · Likely: **76 h** · High: **137 h**
- Ranges, not a fixed quote. `needs_clarification` items carry only a discovery spike.

## Client responsibilities
- Approve/revise this scope; confirm acceptance tests; provide test data and timely feedback.
